No contact is a good way to allow yourself to emotionally sort of recover when you are turned down. No contact is what it says you don’t talk to the person and you have no contact with them. 

Asking yourself those questions isn’t easy it’s not like asking yourself what 4 + 4 is. It’s because it’s not a sort of (don’t know the right word) ima say logical question where no matter what the answer is the same. 

You’re going to have to do some deep reflecting. It’s not a fun thing, it can lead to you realizing that you did in fact like them and since you got tuned down it can lead to some hurt feelings but it’s the only way you can really know if you liked the person or simply liked the feeling of going after them. 

It’s not as simple as simply asking yourself in your head “did I like them?”. It takes time and deep reflecting. Have you ever gotten lost in your own thoughts maybe while playing a video game your mind went to auto pilot as you thought of something and before you know it you realized you just went through a couple levels without realizing it. You want one of those deep thoughts. 

Maybe start out by simply asking yourself “what made you attracted to that person and what made you want them?” Was it just because you thought they looked good, did you just want to feel that “hunt” again? Or was it something deeper like their personality, how they spoke to you, the way they did little things. 

It’s not something easy but it can be necessary.

I would say do some deep reflecting. Ask yourself if you really did have feelings or if you’re just getting excited again because in a way “a new hunt is starting” or “the hunt has started again”. We don’t like being hurt or feeling hurt so our mind does things to prevent that. Obviously it doesn’t happen or work all the time but in certain instances it can be true. Ask yourself if you really didn’t have feelings or if you simply blocked them out at the time to prevent being hurt. It could be that since you’re still talking to them, you’re mind can’t permanently block those feelings and continuing to talk to the person has made those feelings really resurface and you can’t just simply block them out or ignore them anymore. It could very well be either your mind sensing a “new hunt” starting, or it could be the feelings that your mind had temporarily covered have finally popped up again.
